（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. ! D.
I. O. REG
No. 597
Dat. 28. 9. 16
September 25th 1916.

Sir,
About 100 persons attended a memorial service
at the Wusieh Guild on Haining Road on the 24th inst
in honour of Ling Liang Gee林亮吉 who was killed
in a motor car accident on Mohawk Road last month.
The meeting was quiet and orderly.
About 150 natives of Hunan attended a meeting
in the Hunan Guild near St.Catherine's Bridge at 2.30
p.m. on the 24th inst to protest against the
Japanese loan and grant of mining concessions
in Honan. In a truculent speech Tan Zung Vong 谭人凤
an ex-~~states that the rebels of~~
Hunan now in Shanghai would refuse to accept
assistance from the repatriation fund. The
（批：Official）meeting broke up at 4.15 p.m. after much talk but
no decision was arrived at.
The master painters have granted an increase
in wages to their workmen of 30 cash per day to
take effect from the 27th inst. The workmen have
not yet decided to accept the concession.
Considerable pressure seems to have been brought
to bear on the master painters by the authorities
before the increase was agreed to.

Your Obedient Servant,
~~
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
（批：28/9）
（签名：Ash）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探股））
上海公共租界工部局。
C. ! D.
I. O. REG
第 597 号
日期：16年9月28日
1916年9月25日。

先生：
本月24日，约有100人在海宁路的吴协公会参加追悼会，纪念上月在莫霍克路（Mohawk Road）车祸中丧生的林亮吉。会议安静有序。
本月24日下午2时30分，约150名湖南籍人士在圣凯瑟琳桥附近的湖南公会举行集会，抗议日本贷款及授予河南采矿权。谭人凤在发言中态度强硬，称目前在上海的湖南反叛者将拒绝接受遣返基金的援助。会议经过长时间讨论，未达成任何决议，于下午4时15分结束。（批注：官方）
画工行会已同意给工匠每日加薪30文铜钱，自本月27日起生效。工匠们尚未决定是否接受这一让步。
在同意加薪之前，当局似乎对画工行会施加了相当大的压力。

您忠实的仆人，
首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监。
（批注：9/28）
（签名：Ash）
